instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements / revenue-guarantee code-share agreements with major airline partners.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase/revenue-guarantee agreements. FY ends Sep 30. Fuel largely pass-through: 65% of fuel requirements under contract agreements with America West and US Airways (fuel billed directly to code-share partner). Remaining ~35% at company risk (turboprop prorate operations). No hedging program.
